text:
Maya: Quick sync  we need a pocket battlecard for AEs that they can read in 30s. Focus: 3 quick openers (cloud AI, API-first vendors, infra/tooling sellers) + one measurable proof line + 2 closers.
Leo: Good call. Keep it skimmable: bullet intro, claim/counter, stat, CTA.
Sam: Drafting now. Example opener for cloud AI platforms: "Most cloud vendor endpoints give you raw model access, but you end up paying for latency variance and missing production tooling." Counter line: "Redwood provides tuned runtime + autoscale pools so teams hit predictable P95s and cut per-token spend (median savings ~40% in our sample runs)."
Priya: I like the median stat. Add a 1-liner about lock-in risk: "Switching models or regions is nontrivial with some clouds." Counter: "Same API surface across hosted/dedicated/private -> easier migrations."
Maya: Now the API-first vendor opener: "API providers move fast on model features and fine-tuning, but they leave you little control over cost and ops." Counter: "Match features via our model catalog + function-calling and add cost levers (batching, KV cache, quantization) so you can scale without surprise overages.
Sam: For infra/tooling vendors (self-hosted stacks): opener: "You get deep control, but the ops bill is real." Counter: "Redwood gives the observability and deployment primitives teams want without hiring a full infra org: per-route telemetry, canaries, and managed quantization profiles."
Leo: Add one micro-scripts section where SDRs can copy/paste a 3-sentence pitch. Keep it conversational. Example: "Hi, this is NAME from Redwood. We help engineering teams cut inference costs and keep latency predictable while avoiding vendor lock-in. Can I share a one-page that shows a 40% median cost example for a typical embed/generate mix?"
Priya: Routing notes: tag intents as pricing, migration, private-deploy. Pricing -> growth; private-deploy & migration -> AE + solutions eng. Also add keyword rule: "kv cache" -> bench doc.
Maya: Compliance note for public-facing materials: use only the approved condensed metric "~40% median per-token savings in internal benchmark cohort" and link to internal bench doc for reps.
Sam: I'll prepare the single-slide export and a 1-paragraph speaker brief for the May webinar (mini-demo + customer Q&A).
deploy-bot: marketing-assets lint OK for new cheat-sheets folder. :white_check_mark:
Maya: Thanks all. Action: Sam to post slide + copy by EOD, Leo to wire into AE playbook, Priya to update routing sheet.
